preconditions.description: The number of events q is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line.strip()) > 0 for line in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the q event lines is non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all((1 <= v <= 10**18 and 1 <= u <= 10**18 and v != u and (1 <= w <= 10**9 if t == 1 else True)) for t, v, u, w in parsed_events)
preconditions.description: For each event, v and u are positive integers up to 10^18 and distinct; if type 1, w is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(t in (1, 2) for t, _, _, _ in parsed_events)
preconditions.description: Each event type t is either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == len([e for e in parsed_events if e[0] == 2])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type-2 events.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == sum_cost_for_path(parsed_events, i) for i in range(len(stdout_lines)))
postconditions.description: Each output line i contains the sum of current road fees on the unique shortest path between the v and u of the i-th type-2 event, where sum_cost_for_path computes the cumulative fee updates applied to edges on that path.

postconditions.expression: sum_cost_for_path(parsed_events, i) == sum((fee_map.get((min(a, b), max(a, b)), 0) for a, b in path_edges(parsed_events, i)))
postconditions.description: The cost for a query is the sum of fees of all edges on the path, where each edge (x, y) with x<y has a fee accumulated from all type-1 events covering that edge.
